name: postiz-extension
description: A simple chrome & firefox extension template with Vite, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true})" && vite build --config vite.config.chrome.ts && zip -r extension.zip dist
scripts.dev: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true})" && dotenv -e ../../.env -- vite build --config vite.config.chrome.ts --mode development --watch
